meta.name: mass-ulw
meta.description: Run a dependency graph of child agents in one call with the native dag tool. Use when the user asks for mass-ulw, a DAG of tasks, fan-out/fan-in work, or multi-agent execution where some tasks must wait on others.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 一次调用编排多个智能体按依赖顺序执行
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理多个智能体协同完成相互依赖的任务
copy.tagline_en: Orchestrate multiple agents with dependencies in one call
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage agent workflows where tasks depend on each other

howto.what: 当你要求运行多个子代理且它们之间有先后依赖时，Claude 会用 dag 工具把任务组织成依赖图，按依赖顺序分波执行，全部完成后返回结果。
howto.when: 当用户提到 mass-ulw、任务 DAG、扇出/扇入 等，或需要多代理按依赖顺序执行时触发。

say.text: 用 mass-ulw 跑一个文档刷新流程：先审计、再重写、最后验证。
say.note: Claude 会按依赖分波执行这三个子任务。

say.text: 创建一个任务 DAG：任务 A 和 B 并行，C 等 A、B 完成后再做。
say.note: 依赖关系被尊重，C 会等待前序完成。

say.text: 帮我用 dag 工具编排这个多代理任务，把需要先完成的任务标记为依赖。
say.note: Claude 会定义节点并启动运行。

howto.what_en: When asked to run multiple child agents with ordering constraints, Claude uses the dag tool to define and execute a dependency graph, running nodes in parallel waves as dependencies clear, then returns the final result.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for mass-ulw, a task DAG, fan-out/fan-in, or multi-agent execution where some tasks must wait on others.

say_en.text: Run a docs-refresh DAG with mass-ulw: audit, then rewrite, then verify.
say_en.note: Claude will execute the three nodes in dependency order.

say_en.text: Create a task DAG where A and B run in parallel, and C waits for both.
say_en.note: Dependencies are respected during the run.

say_en.text: Use the dag tool to orchestrate this multi-agent job, marking prerequisites as dependencies.
say_en.note: Claude defines the nodes and starts the run.
